name: smooth_audio
description:
One-shot polish pass over the ACTIVE timeline's audio: every touching audio cut gets a short centered audio crossfade (`builtin:tr-audio-cross-fade`, default 4 frames = 2 each side), and every exposed clip edge (gap, timeline start/end, or a silent neighbor) gets a short fade-in/fade-out (default 4 frames). Applies to audio items and video items with audible audio, per track. Use when the user asks to smooth audio, remove pops/clicks at cuts, or "add small crossfades everywhere".

Idempotent and non-destructive — safe to run repeatedly:
- Seams that already have an audio transition, and edges that already have a fade, are left untouched.
- Locked, muted, and hidden tracks, muted clips, and video clips whose asset has no audio track are skipped and reported.
- Seams without enough source handle material for a real crossfade fall back to a fade-out/fade-in pair.
- Fades are clamped so fade-in + fade-out never exceed a clip's length.

Everything commits as ONE atomic batch; a failure rolls back the whole sweep. Returns counts (crossfades, fadeIns, fadeOuts, fallbackSeams) plus per-reason skip lists with item id prefixes. `validateOnly:true` returns the plan without committing.

Not for stylistic transitions: for an audible, deliberate crossfade on one specific cut use `edit_item` with an explicit duration instead.

crossfadeDurationInFrames.description: Crossfade length in frames at touching cuts, centered on the cut (default 4 = 2 frames each side). Clamped per seam by available source handles.

fadeDurationInFrames.description: Fade-in/out length in frames at exposed clip edges (default 4). Stored as seconds using the timeline fps.

projectId.description: Existing project ID from the editor URL or list_projects. Pass this when continuing work on an existing project and the external MCP session is not already targeted.

trackIds.description: Restrict the sweep to these track ids (full ids). Omit to sweep every track on the active timeline.

validateOnly.description: Plan and report without committing any change.
